info.title: PlaneMem checkpoint save and original receipt
info.description: Source-only two existing POST contracts. Load checkpoint-write/checkpoint-read/session-activity-read/session-start schemas and session-reads/context-history/search HTTP components locally. No runtime change, generator/validator execution, SDK/Mock machine-contract consumption or release evidence.

servers.description: Relative Gateway base; configure deployment origin/base.

x-runtime-boundaries.authority: Both require session.write Policy, entry audit and independent authenticated_client=true handler gate; signed boundary requires trusted scope/actor/client. Configured OPA replaces local Policy, not verified-client gate. Unsigned compatibility cannot satisfy this gate. Optional expected actor/client headers are independently exact constraints. Top-level actor/client/from_client/scope claims must match signed context. Session creator need not equal writer. Saved-pack binding also authorizes and audits context.pack.read before reading package; restricted visibility requires actual data.restricted.read.
x-runtime-boundaries.http: Generic pre-auth1MiB JSON-object parser; empty/malformed/nonobject/oversize body400 INVALID_JSON, nonfatal UTF-8 decode. No dedicated content-type/encoding/framing/cache/Range or duplicate-header rejection; generic Node header behavior applies. URL query ignored. Route session_id overwrites raw body session_id. No dedicated full-response byte cap, whole-handler deadline, concurrency capacity, database cancellation or post-read token-expiry check. Historical GET2/8MiB limits do not apply to these POSTs.
x-runtime-boundaries.input: All six string arrays required, with empty/whitespace/duplicate text and ordering preserved. Effective expected_version from header or body must be nonnegative safe at extraction; fresh write compares exact current live-session version. If-Match and If-Match-Version must agree with each other; selected header replaces body version without comparison. Unknown body fields fingerprinted. Key optional for unbound/legacy-inline saves, required for saved context_pack_id. Selected header key wins over body without equality check; selected key only nonempty string, no255/non-whitespace validation here. SDK and receipt query are stricter and cannot query every weak legacy key.
x-runtime-boundaries.fingerprint: Key=SHA256 canonical [actor_id,client_id,rawKey], stored with scoped session checkpoint. Fingerprint sorts effective body including route session_id and effective expected_version, deletes body idempotency_key, retains unknown fields, explicit identity fields and original legacy pack/memory. Resolved saved-pack document is not added to fingerprint. Process header-key cache additionally binds raw body/current authority/version; matching cache re-enters handler, mismatch may reject before database. Body-only keys skip this process cache; unkeyed saves create separate checkpoints.
x-runtime-boundaries.append: Postgres transaction first locks visible nondeleted valid-classification project FOR SHARE, then scoped parent session FOR UPDATE. Existing key checks fingerprint then maps original checkpoint before fresh state/version checks. New write requires running/paused session and exact expected session version, allocates greatest checkpoint revision+1 and inserts notes/references/request key/fingerprint atomically. Parent session is locked but status/version are NOT changed; checkpoint revision is independent. No safe-overflow guard on Number(latest.revision)+1; SQL BIGINT constraints are not a safe-JS-version check. Stored replay maps Number/JSON fields without full checkpoint-record validation.
x-runtime-boundaries.saved-pack: context_pack_id and legacy context_pack are mutually exclusive. Saved ID resolution occurs on EVERY save/replay before checkpoint receipt lookup: extra context.pack.read authorization/audit, database transaction, project sync-stream lock and readable project share lock, scoped stored pack/read_restricted filtering, complete stored hash/budget/expiry/item/manifest and recursive source/dependency checks. Same transaction then appends/replays checkpoint with an isolated service cache. Existing receipt cannot bypass expired/stale/hidden package. Expiry is checked during package read, not again after all dependent reads or commit. Lock coordinates cooperating source writers, not arbitrary SQL or permanent validity.
x-runtime-boundaries.legacy: Inline legacy pack only checks same scope, nonempty pack_hash and valid source entries; no full pack, stored hash, freshness or provider verification. Memory ref only checks same scope, nonempty page_ref/hash, positive safe revision and valid sources; arbitrary extensions retained. No memory provider call. Absent store retains in-memory fixture; custom store lacking appendCheckpoint uses serialized local-cache preparation/saveCheckpoint fallback without a durable original-key ledger guarantee. PostgreSQL has no such fallback on failure.
x-runtime-boundaries.output: Full checkpoint record with current outer trace and saved inner trace; outer source list equals inner list. Six notes preserved; sources ordered session, optional bound pack, memory sources, pack sources with first type/id occurrence retained. Reference/source extensions survive. state_hash uses existing FNV-style32-bit routine, rendered sha256: plus8 hex despite not being SHA-256; it is not a cryptographic proof. Saved-pack context_pack_hash is a real stored content digest, legacy inline hash is supplied text. No created_at/current session version/ETag/explicit pack-state. Mapper does not perform complete stored-row validation; strict SDK may reject nominal200.
x-runtime-boundaries.receipt: Closed logical request_key/checkpoint; original command open with all six original arrays and positive safe effective expected_version. Optional original key/session must match. Nested actor/client are fingerprint fields on HTTP; SDK binding additionally compares them to expected identity. Outer raw session_id is overwritten/removed. Valid new header key/version parsed then ignored; malformed version headers still fail. One SQL snapshot checks current visible parent plus same-key checkpoint, no locks or write replay. Missing parent404, visible no row200 not-observed. Matching record only checks fingerprint, ULID checkpoint/optional pack ID, positive safe Number(revision) and exact optional pack binding; no notes/source/hash/memory/current session version/state or current pack reread. Returns minimal recorded with not-checked or not-observed, empty sources/no ETag.
x-runtime-boundaries.sdk: createCheckpoint requires valid original key/version options and complete expected identity (explicit or fixed client context), no mismatch with configured key/version/If-Match or optional body key/version/session/actor/client. Strict declared new-command fields; legacy hash and memory text nonblank<=4096 UTF-16, references JSON-only finite/plain-object/depth<=32, notes unchanged. Sends original key/If-Match and expected identity headers. getCheckpointReceipt deep-clones original query and sends only scope/trace/expected identity, clearing inherited write preconditions. Both use generic JSON transport, no dedicated bytes/media/exact200/trace-header/length guarantees or method timeout/signal options. Fetch default30s starts after credential acquisition; custom transport has no whole-call deadline here. No automatic retry/key replacement.
x-runtime-boundaries.sdk-output: Save parser checks complete original notes/scope/session/pack binding/hash/memory equality, safe positive checkpoint revision, nonblank<=4096 saved/current trace and state hash. It does not recompute state hash or compare checkpoint revision to session version. Inner/outer sources equal and unique type/id; unbound/legacy expected sources equal fully, saved-pack expected session/pack/memory sources form exact prefix with remaining resolved-pack sources allowed. Reference/source extensions preserved; top-level unknown fields discarded. Optional ETag accepted only when equal to checkpoint revision; built-in server does not emit it. Receipt parser checks minimal result, original pack presence/value, exact current trace, empty sources and no ETag.

post.summary: Save complete progress notes under the original session version
post.x-conditional-policy-action: context.pack.read uses context.read when context_pack_id is supplied
post.description: New checkpoint revision does not change parent session version. Saved pack requires stable key and current package checks even on original-key replay; inline legacy pack is only an unverified historical reference. Original response is complete saved checkpoint, without current validity guarantee.

post.summary: Observe a previous checkpoint request without consuming its saved pack
post.description: Requires current verified session writer and original identity/key/full body/effective version. Valid new write headers ignored. No context.read check or stored pack read; historical metadata only. not-observed does not prove failure or permit replacing original request.

SessionId.name: session_id
SessionId.description: HTTP save extracts nonempty path; scoped storage resolves parent. SDK/receipt require ULID. Same-named raw body field overwritten, not compared.

SaveKey.name: Idempotency-Key
SaveKey.description: Header wins over body key without comparison; selected key only checked nonempty. Required in header/body for saved pack, otherwise optional legacy HTTP. SDK/receipt enforce1..255 non-whitespace UTF-16; retain a compatible original key to allow later lookup.

SaveIfMatch.name: If-Match
SaveIfMatch.description: Original parent session version, not checkpoint revision. Safe nonnegative parse, leading zeros allowed; must agree with If-Match-Version. Header overrides body expected_version; no body equality check.

SaveVersion.name: If-Match-Version
SaveVersion.description: Alternative digits-only original session version0..MAX_SAFE. Without version headers body expected_version is required. Fresh save requires exact current live-session version; old keyed replay precedes this comparison.

SaveSuccess.description: Complete original checkpoint, current outer/saved inner trace, same source arrays. Parent version unchanged; no ETag/current-pack state. Existing stored replay is mapped without full server response parser.

ReceiptSuccess.description: Historical recorded/not-observed. Positive safe checkpoint revision and optional original pack ID; recorded always not-checked. Empty sources/no ETag/no notes.

Error.description: Application error envelope; early parser/auth/proxy may lack trace header or differ. Preserve original request after uncertain save. retryable never authorizes automatic new key/retry.

BadInput.description: INVALID_INPUT for required notes, selected key/version, malformed/mutually exclusive references or original query; CONTEXT_SCOPE_MISMATCH for fresh inline/memory scope mismatch. INVALID_REQUEST_CONTEXT for malformed/disagreeing version headers. Generic pre-auth malformed/empty/nonobject/oversize JSON is400 INVALID_JSON, not413. Lower service SESSION_ACCESS_DENIED falls through400. retryable=false.

Unauthenticated.description: Signed boundary UNAUTHENTICATED401, retryable=false. Unsigned compatibility cannot satisfy verified-client requirement.

Denied.description: DENIED403 for identity/scope/Policy/verified-client or extra saved-pack context.read authorization; retryable=false. Scoped invisible parent/pack normally404.

NotFound.description: SESSION_NOT_FOUND for missing/hidden project or parent. Saved-pack resolution precedes parent/receipt and may return CONTEXT_PACK_NOT_FOUND for missing/hidden project/pack. retryable=false.

ReceiptNotFound.description: SESSION_NOT_FOUND for missing/hidden parent/project; retryable=false. Visible parent without original key returns200 not-observed.

Conflict.description: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED for process/durable fingerprint mismatch; fresh SESSION_VERSION_CONFLICT/SESSION_STATE_CONFLICT; saved-pack CONTEXT_PACK_STALE for changed/unavailable source or dependency chain. retryable=false. Pack check before replay; original checkpoint replay before fresh lifecycle/version check.

ReceiptConflict.description: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED for historical fingerprint mismatch, retryable=false. No fresh CAS/state/pack validation.

Expired.description: CONTEXT_PACK_EXPIRED410 on saved-pack resolution, including keyed replay; retryable=false. Prior successful checkpoint may still exist.

SaveInvalid.description: CONTEXT_PACK_INVALID500 for saved package/hash/budget/metadata corruption, retryable=false. Generic unbound append/database/JSON-mapping non-ContractError becomes INTERNAL_ERROR500 retryable=true. No complete server checkpoint response parser is added here.

ReceiptInvalid.description: SESSION_RECEIPT_INVALID500 for matching row with invalid ID/revision/optional pack binding, retryable=false. Notes/state hash/source integrity are not checked. Generic INTERNAL_ERROR defaults true.

SaveUnavailable.description: Saved-pack path missing DB or non-ContractError from entire consuming transaction becomes CONTEXT_PACK_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE503 retryable=true; unbound Postgres append lacks this wrapper and normally emits INTERNAL_ERROR500 instead. WORKBENCH_AUTH_UNAVAILABLE/AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE503 true also possible.

ReceiptUnavailable.description: SESSION_RECEIPT_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE503 for missing database or query error, retryable=true; auth/audit503 also possible. No memory-cache fallback or original command mutation.
